welcome.title: Here, someone actually reads your profile
welcome.lede: We hope~ At the very least, you can't send a like without scrolling to the end of the text. No photos at all: only what you write about yourself.
welcome.privacy: And remember: this app doesn't store your data all that securely. Don't write anything you couldn't survive in someone else's hands.

profile.ownGenderHint: Careful! This is YOUR gender, not the one you're looking for. So you don't turn up in front of people you'd rather avoid, heh~
profile.seekingHint: You can leave this empty — then the feed shows everyone. Limiting who you talk to is a strange thing to do.
profile.bioHint: What keeps you up, what makes you tick, and do you even like that expression? Your take on vaccines, science, and on three funnily similar letter combos: GMO, HOMO, HOMEO.
profile.bioPlaceholder: Write it as it is. This is what people will read.
profile.appearanceHint: Optional. If you feel like it, describe yourself however you want. Free form, no photos here.
profile.appearancePlaceholder: For example: tall, permanently in black, worried eyebrows.
profile.tagsHint: Comma separated. People find you in the feed by these — and you find yours the same way.
profile.questionsLede: Answering is optional, but these answers are what people read most carefully.
profile.deleteConfirm: Delete the whole profile? This can't be undone.
profile.hiddenNotice: This profile is hidden from the feed after a report. Edit and save it to bring it back.
profile.bioMinHint: At least 300 characters — shorter than that isn't a profile, it's a classified ad.

feed.title: Feed
feed.empty: Nobody here yet. Either everyone's taken, or the filters are too strict.
feed.needProfile: Write your own profile first — reading others without one isn't fair.

read.gateHint: The like button appears once you've read to the end.
read.matched: Mutual! You can exchange contacts now.

report.title: What's wrong with this profile?
report.empty_or_stub: Empty or placeholder instead of text
report.not_about_person: Ad, or text that isn't about a person
report.sent: Report sent, we'll look at it by hand.

matches.title: Likes
matches.empty: Empty for now. A like becomes a match only when it's mutual.
matches.consentPending: You agreed. Waiting for them to agree too.

games.title: Text games
games.lede: You can play with people you've matched with.
games.empty: No one to play with yet — you need at least one match.

blog.title: Microblog
blog.lede: Short notes about what's going on. Everyone can see them, and they extend your profile.
blog.filterHint: Filters look at the person's profile, not the post text: this is for finding people, not posts.

common.errorNetwork: The server isn't responding. Check your connection.
common.errorAuth: The app couldn't confirm it's really you. Reopen it from Telegram.

chat.title: Conversations
chat.empty: No conversations yet. They start with a message or a comment on someone's paragraph.
chat.localWarning: Conversations are stored on this device only. Clear the app data and the history is gone for good.
chat.consentHint: Both of you have to agree. Until then your @username stays hidden.
chat.needMatch: Contact sharing opens after a mutual like.

comment.title: Comment on the selected part
comment.placeholder: What caught you in this paragraph?
